subject: english
question:
**Identify the segment in the sentence which contains a grammatical error.**

He didn't know how getting to the Guest House so he stopped to ask the way.
solution:
The erroneous part of the sentence is:** how getting to**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Replace "how getting to" with "how to get" to make the sentence correct.
 
• '**to**' is used as a preposition to show movement towards a condition or state and not as an infinitive marker. 
 
• We never use how + verb + ing in a sentence.
 
• The basic rules are either to use the regular verb after how or to use a preposition (to) in case of an irregular verb.
 
• **Example - **
 
 
• *How do you build a house?*
 
• *How to drive a car?*
 
 
 
• *​"***Get to" **is also a** phrasal verb **which means** "to arrive"**
 
• *​*So,**"how to get"** should used in the given sentence.
 
• The implied meaning of the sentence is: "**He stopped to inquire about the route because he had no idea how to go to the guest house.**"

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4.**

**Corrected sentence:** *He didn't know **how to get __**to the Guest House so he stopped to ask the way.*

7d
